release_notes: Ban 0.0.32: sua loi in PDF va nhap XML — (1) truoc day neu mot dong chu khong ve duoc, app van bao 'da in xong' va ban PDF thieu noi dung; nay bao that bai va ghi log; (2) bo co che du phong dung font Helvetica (font nay khong co dau tieng Viet nen chu bi sai/thanh o vuong); (3) dong file PDF dung cach khi gap loi, tranh khoa tep tren Windows; (4) gop nhieu PDF ma thieu tep thi co canh bao trong log; (5) nhap hoa don BAN RA tu XML thieu MST nguoi mua khong con tu gan nguoi mua la chinh cong ty minh. Them test dung PDF that de kiem tra chu tieng Viet.
